engineering_decision_request.question: Resolve Functionality row 1721: whether POWER_PSU1~4 and the Procedure's PWR_PDB_PSU are approved aliases, distinct PSU/PDB measurements or an erroneous reference; define the canonical four resources, PSU/PDB/feed mapping, input/output domain, units/scaling, sample interval, load tolerance and SPEC while preserving Master.

review_improvement: Prevents a different power domain or broad PDB family from being accepted as the four per-PSU measurements solely because values and units look plausible.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power telemetry is only meaningful with its electrical boundary and averaging interval. A PDB feed and an individual PSU can both report watts yet legitimately differ because of redundancy, conversion loss or aggregation. Therefore the name mismatch is a semantic conflict, not a cosmetic alias, until the owner defines the measurement topology.
